title: MA2H Response (v0.5)
description: Hub->Agent response envelope for a resolved ask/task. Pushed (signed, see spec 9.2) or embedded in the GET body. `resolution` is a flat union; per-verb validity (ask: answered|declined|cancelled|expired; task: completed|dismissed|expired) is Hub-enforced + covered by a conformance vector.

resolution_id.description: Hub-assigned, opaque, random; identical across every channel and retry. Agent dedups on (in_reply_to, resolution_id). v0.5 responses mint it in the res_ namespace (the conditional below; spec §8.7.1) — pre-0.5 responses keep their opaque ids, per the unchanged-wire contract.

agent.description: responseAgent: routing identity only (runtime NOT required on the return leg).

defaulted.description: True iff the resolution came from default_on_expire (then actor MUST be system:default_on_expire).

response.description: Present for ask; for task present only to carry comment/checklist (no value); never for notify.

value.description: ask only: chosen option value (string, select/confirm) or the input object (input). Absent for task.

checklist.description: Task resolutions only: the final §5.3 checklist state (typed in v0.5 — the §8.8 resolve binding carries it over the wire). Base item shape matches v0.4's action.checklist (text required, done optional default false) so a stored legacy Response stays valid; a >= 0.5 Response states each item's doneness (the root conditional; same shape as resolve-request.schema.json).

state.description: Opaque agent blob round-tripped verbatim. UNTRUSTED until the agent verifies integrity it applied (spec 9.3).

allOf.$comment: answered/declined/cancelled are ask-only resolutions (spec §7) and checklists are task-only (spec §6, §8.8) — a checklist on an ask Response is malformed.

The res_ ack-key namespace (spec §8.7.1) is normative for v0.5-minted responses only; 0.3/0.4 responses keep their opaque ids (unchanged wire, MIGRATION contract). Mailbox response ENTRIES always require minor >= 5, so every ack key on the drain is namespaced.
